description: Reference / static data (§2.7, §4.8): the canonical instruments.json identifier map for all 30 trades (CUSIP/ISIN -> FIGI -> ticker via OpenFIGI) and SEC EDGAR XBRL company fundamentals + hyperscaler capex used for stress-scenario calibration (§2.8). Holiday calendars, day-count conventions and ISDA definitions are shipped by QuantLib / are documents — nothing to download. See docs/design/AITrade_quantlib_portfolio_marketdata.md §1, §2.7, §4.8.

notes: Reference identifiers (OpenFIGI) are effectively static — re-run only when a trade is added (one-time setup, not in the weekly loop).
EDGAR XBRL fundamentals/capex update quarterly after each earnings season; an 8-year lookback from 2018 captures the pre-AI-capex baseline through the current GPU-capex boom for stress sizing.

portfolio.notes: SPX is a cash index (no security-level FIGI); priced off ECB/CBOE data, not OpenFIGI.
On-the-run CUSIP rolls at each auction; resolved dynamically by the bonds/treasurydirect source, not a static FIGI.
OTC swap — no security FIGI; identified by SOFR curve nodes.
OTC FX/NDF — no security FIGI; identified by currency pair.
Single-name CDS — no security FIGI; reference entity = bond issuer (trade #17).
Single-name CDS — reference entity = bond issuer (trade #18).
Index CDS — composition reference is the S&P DJI annex (credit pipeline), not OpenFIGI.

openfigi.name: OpenFIGI Mapping — CUSIP/ISIN/ticker -> FIGI (canonical instrument map)
openfigi.description: Resolves every trade carrying a figi_query (equities/ETFs by ticker, corp bonds by CUSIP) to its FIGI + standardized name/ticker/exchange, then writes the full 30-trade portfolio (FIGI-enriched where resolvable) to instruments.json — the canonical cross-source identifier table (CUSIP for TRACE/EDGAR, ticker for Yahoo/CBOE, FIGI as the canonical key). One-time setup; re-run only when a trade is added. Free anonymous tier: 25 requests/min, max 10 mapping jobs per request (a free X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY raises this to 25 jobs/6s but is not required at this volume).
openfigi.auth_notes: The API key is OPTIONAL — anonymous tier (25 req/min, 10 jobs/req) is sufficient for this one-time map. If OPENFIGI_API_KEY is unset the HttpClient logs a benign 'env var not set' warning and proceeds anonymously.

edgar_xbrl._deprecated: DEPRECATED 2026-07 (harness-audit F2). Superseded by ARag facts_lookup (POST /api/v1/facts/lookup), which serves the same issuer fundamentals WITH filing citations and is the path scenariogen actually consumes. This standalone CSV was never wired into pricing/risk (the §4.8 use-case-2 credit-spread-stress consumer was never built), so ARag is now the single source of truth for issuer fundamentals. Disabled (no longer refreshed) and de-listed from the DQ gate; the downloader code is retained so it can be re-enabled if a non-ARag fundamentals feed is ever needed.
edgar_xbrl.name: SEC EDGAR XBRL — company fundamentals + hyperscaler capex (stress calibration)
edgar_xbrl.description: Per-issuer XBRL fact series via the companyconcept API: hyperscaler GPU/capex spend for the AI-capex bust scenario (§2.8 use case 1) and leverage/coverage/liquidity tags for bond-issuer credit-spread stress (§4.8 use case 2). Quarterly cadence (refresh after each earnings season). Requires a descriptive User-Agent or SEC returns 403. Tags that an issuer does not report (e.g. Revenues vs RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax) return 404 and are skipped.

tags.PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets: Capex (productive-assets tag) — used by AMZN/NVDA instead of the PP&E tag; both are the GPU/datacenter spend for AI stress calibration
tags.Revenues: Revenue (primary tag) — revenue trajectory for equity + credit stress sizing
tags.RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcluding: Revenue (ASC 606 tag) — fallback for issuers not using us-gaap:Revenues
tags.LongTermDebtNoncurrent: Long-term debt — leverage ratio for bond spread stress
tags.NetIncomeLoss: Net income — interest-coverage numerator, issuer credit quality
tags.CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue: Cash — liquidity cushion, downside scenario floor
